action.objective: Commit the verified bishop retreat Be3, keeping material intact and central control; adapt to Black's rook lift.
action.rationale: d2e3 is the only commit_ready_move: verified to effective depth 3 with exact +44, safety complete (no mate-in-one), tactical_refutation not_found. It reoccupies the e3-f4 diagonal, defends f4/d4/g1, and no Black capture wins material immediately. Broader depth-1 scores for other moves are shallow and not comparable; analysis_nodes_available is 0, so no further evidence is obtainable.
